standard.summary: 平滑后的全局梯度范数低于它时，Pilot 认为训练停滞，往上调学习率（boost 档）。
standard.effect: 默认 1e-6。设 0 或负数启动报错。
standard.whenToUse: 梯度经常接近 0、训练“睡着”时用。
standard.avoidWhen: 阈值调太高会把正常训练误判成停滞。

standard_en.summary: When the smoothed global gradient norm drops below this, the Pilot treats training as stalled and raises the learning rate (boost gear).
standard_en.effect: Default 1e-6. 0 or negative fails closed at startup.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use when gradients hover near zero and training falls asleep.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too high a threshold misreads healthy training as stalled.
